topic: How check-cashing stores profit from the unbanked

sources.claim: 4.2% of US households (~5.6 million) were unbanked in 2023, lowest since the survey began in 2009
sources.source: FDIC 2023 National Survey of Unbanked and Underbanked Households (published Nov 2024)

sources.claim: Check-cashing and prepaid-card services charge fees for transactions a checking account typically handles free
sources.source: General consumer-finance industry knowledge, consistent with CFPB consumer guidance
